sources.story_title: LeiLauni Scheideman (President, Alaska Airlines Flight Attendants Council 30, AFA-CWA): the claim that a federal AI bill 'would override state laws protecting workers, kids and communities.'
Obernolte-Trahan bipartisan discussion draft preempts only AI 'development' rules for three years and states 'preemption would not apply to laws related to the use or deployment of AI models.'
HCR 3, the only Alaska AI task-force measure, stuck in House Finance with no floor vote. Alaska has no enacted state AI law to preempt.
